gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-matangi: Matangi has strokes like twine pressed flat, with rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase. Matangi in sans-serif form keeps a long page easy going, while Nasalization floats its short-ascendered heading letters well apart above it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-maven-pro: Friendly, that heading: Nasalization spaces its letters far apart with a c opened like calipers. Maven Pro below has a high-waisted lowercase and a gentle, uniform line thickness, so the sans text settles under the display type without competing.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-michroma: Nasalization draws horizontals and verticals at identical thickness, like rod stock. Michroma follows with wide berth around every letter and a tall-bodied lowercase, so a long passage in plain sans moves slowly, spaced out and deliberate.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable is the word for Nasalization, with short ascenders and a big lowercase floating well apart. And Miriam Libre brings the weight of drawn wire and a lowercase as stout as cast iron capitals, which gives the sans-serif body real stature.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-mochiy-pop-on: Mochiy Pop One reads with very large lowercase eyes, letters hung like clothespins on a line. Nasalization is best at the heading, with its calipers-open c and wide spacing, while the sans body does its best work as a steady, laser-cut run of text.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-mochiy-pop-p-: Mochiy Pop P One leaves a wide stretch of blank space between each letter, and its lowercase is sizable. And Nasalization above it also floats its letters apart, so a long passage in sans moves unhurried and without any brush-like swelling.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-montserrat-un: Nasalization opens with short ascenders and a big lowercase, its letters floating well apart. Montserrat Underline answers with breathing counters and round bowls whose walls never swell, and its oversized lowercase makes the sans text sit comfortably beneath that display heading.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-mozilla-headl: Mozilla Headline has big-bodied lowercase letters and a splayed c terminal that gives the sans a friendly flare. Nasalization does its best work in display, with no stress tilting its rounds.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-mozilla-text: Neutral is how Mozilla Text feels, its lowercase looking bold because the bodies are so tall and its terminals flaring outward in plain sans fashion. Nasalization is best at the top, keeping thickness constant around its curves.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-nata-sans: Clean lines define Nata Sans, with a large central band in the text and curved letters that leave wide, unclosed mouths. And Nasalization above it adds short ascenders and a c opened like calipers, so the sans-serif body feels steady beneath it.
